title: Fleet Manifest
description: Per-target runtime state snapshot produced by Phase 448 probe scripts. See docs/fleet-drift/schema-versioning.md for forward-compat rules. schema_version '1.0' is the initial version; additionalProperties: true is set everywhere so future schema versions remain readable by old tools.

schema_version.description: Semver-like schema version. Initial value '1.0'. Minor bumps = additive fields. Major bumps = breaking field changes (requires migration doc).

target_id.description: Stable target identifier. Format for role+index targets: '{role}_{ip_suffix_or_index}' (e.g. server_23, pod_1..pod_8, pos_130, james_27). Role-only targets: bono_vps, cloud_admin, cloud_racecontrol. Composite: relay_james, relay_vps.

host.description: Hostname or IP string -- whichever the probe used to reach the target.

ip.description: Primary IPv4 or IPv6 address. For cloud targets, resolved A/AAAA record.

role.description: Target class. Drives probe path selection in Phase 448 and severity mapping in Phase 452 DIFF-03.

probed_at_ist.description: ISO-8601 with explicit +05:30 offset. IST -- NOT UTC. Rust tracing logs are UTC; probes must convert before writing here.

probe_status.description: ok = all sub-probes succeeded. probe_failed = target unreachable, no data collected. partial = target reachable but >=1 sub-probe failed; probe_errors[] populated.

binary_sha256.description: Map from binary filename (e.g. 'racecontrol.exe', 'rc-agent.exe') to lowercase hex sha256. Empty object '{}' when probe_status != ok.

build_id.description: Short git hash from Rust env!(GIT_HASH) if the primary binary embeds it. null for targets that don't expose build_id (POS kiosk frontends, VPS services without GIT_HASH).

config_hash.description: Map from config filename (e.g. 'racecontrol.toml', 'pod-1.toml') to lowercase hex sha256 of file contents.

running_procs.description: Process snapshot from tasklist /V (Windows) or ps (Linux). cmdline_hash = sha256 of full command line -- NEVER raw cmdline because env var values may leak.

scheduled_tasks.description: Windows schtasks /Query /V /FO LIST output normalized. Linux targets emit cron entries with state='enabled'/'disabled'.

autostart_entries.description: Windows autostart surfaces enumerated per CLAUDE.md 'Autostart Enumeration' rule. schtask entries duplicate scheduled_tasks rows that are registered as autostart.

env_vars_hash.description: sha256 of sorted env variable NAMES only (newline-joined, LF not CRLF). SECURITY BOUNDARY: values NEVER hashed or stored -- even hashed secrets leak entropy. Empty-hash sentinel (sha256 of empty string 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855') permitted when probe_status='probe_failed'.

last_deploy_ts.description: ISO-8601 IST timestamp (+05:30 offset) of the most recent deploy affecting this target. Derived from SWAPLOG.md (Server .23) or state/deploy-ledger/<target_id>.jsonl (Phase 455 LIFECYCLE-02). null when no deploy history available.

probe_errors.description: Populated when probe_status='partial' or 'probe_failed'. Each entry names the failed sub-probe (e.g. 'tasklist', 'schtasks_query', 'reg_query_hklm_run') and its error string. Consumed by Phase 452 diff tool to distinguish 'target down' from 'ran but incomplete data'.
